audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Mordekaiser Levels 3 through 2+ items on both layers, while the page's own prose says the opposite at four of those rows: whys[2] 'his E stun holds you inside the true-damage center... taking the trade', whys[3] 'he wins the extended fights', whys[5] 'out-trades your first-item all-in', whys[6] 'even'. Packet levelChart is [Sett, Skill, Sett, Sett, Mordekaiser, Sett, Skill] and the win rate is 47.81% over 3322 games.
audit.why: Sett is the favoured side here. Facebreaker into a charged Haymaker deals true damage through the centre, which ignores the HP and MR Mordekaiser stacks; Mordekaiser's one owned window is Level 6, where Realm of Death removes The Show Stopper, Sett's team and any gank from the fight.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Sett, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 Sett, Levels 4-5 Sett, Level 6 Mordekaiser, First item Sett, 2+ items Skill. Proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and all real: Lvl 1 Sett passive/grit, Lvl 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), 1st item Sett bruiser spike, Lvl 2-3 Facebreaker into Haymaker.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) spikes[1].text writes 'his R Show Stopper' — the ability is The Show Stopper (flagged by the packet as a suspect name). (b) Facebreaker is described everywhere as a stun with no condition. Riot's text: it pulls enemies on OPPOSITE sides of Sett and stuns them; if enemies were only on one side, they are SLOWED instead. In a 1v1 with no minions flanking you, Facebreaker is a slow, not a stun. That is the single most useful unstated fact in the lane and the page's 'Get E-stunned' don't is built on the wrong premise.
audit.why: It changes how you position for the all-in: keep yourself on one side of him and his grab does not lock you into the true-damage centre of Haymaker.
audit.corrected: The Show Stopper (R, 400 range, 120/100/80s). Facebreaker is 490 range on 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and only stuns when it catches enemies on both sides of him — alone you are slowed. Haymaker is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and scales with the Grit he stored from damage you dealt him, so hitting him feeds it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'R when it's down' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Haymaker 18-12s and Facebreaker 16-10s are the two clocks the lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Commit once Haymaker's Grit is spent (18-12s) and Facebreaker is down (16-10s).

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Sett off his wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every Haymaker cooldown.
edits.after: Facebreaker (16-10s) drags you into the true-damage centre of a charged Haymaker before your shield is banked — bait the grab first, then run the Q-auto-E pattern.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Sett must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Facebreaker into Haymaker is true damage, so HP stacking won't save you at 4-5 — trade only once the grab is spent on its 16-10s.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: His bruiser spike plus a full Haymaker beats your first item: the true-damage centre punches your shield. No slugging without R.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Sett's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: You keep the isolation R, he keeps the true-damage slugfest — it settles on who lands first: your Realm on its 100s or his Facebreaker on its 10s.

edits.before: Realm of Death banishes Sett into a 1v1 shadow realm where his R Show Stopper, his team, and any gank can't reach you — your cleanest kill window, take it before he's banked a fat Haymaker.
edits.after: Realm of Death banishes Sett into a 1v1 shadow realm where The Show Stopper, his team, and any gank can't reach you — your cleanest kill window, take it on the 140s before he banks a fat Haymaker.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — His shield + true-damage burst. R when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Sett Facebreaker: Pulls enemies on both sides together and stuns if hit from both sides. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker: shield + true-damage burst on 18-12s, and it grows with the damage you deal him. R once it is spent. - Sett Facebreaker: 490-range pull on 16-10s; it only stuns from both sides, alone you are slowed.

edits.before: Track Sett's Haymaker: His shield + true-damage burst. R when it’s down. When it is down — R him — the realm is yours.

notes: Chart flip is the substantive change: at 47.81% over 3322 games this is Sett-favoured, and four of the seven 'why' lines already said Sett won the stage while the chart said Mordekaiser. Same misfiring flag as the other mordekaiser matchups: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json marks Obliterate (Q) with grounding 'shuts off enemy dashes' when Riot's description of Obliterate says nothing of the kind — I wrote no grounding claim.
